properties: every nontrivial cut exceeds its smaller shore

augmentation: Greedily add the lexicographically first absent unordered old pair in the same original bipartition part with both artificial degrees <k and current distance >=g-1. Stop when no pair is legal.
final_graph: Retain every original seed edge. Subdivide each artificial edge once, using a distinct new vertex. Keep old labels; label new vertices by their sorted old-endpoint pairs.
no_matching_cut_argument: If both colours occur on the unchanged seed, restrict the cut there. Otherwise any oppositely coloured new vertex has two distinct crossing neighbours.
